title: Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue
artist: Ray Henderson / Sam M. Lewis and Joe Young
attribution: Music by Ray Henderson (died 1970), words by Sam M. Lewis (died 1959) and Joe Young (died 1939); published as "Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue (Has Anybody Seen My Girl?)" by Leo Feist, Inc. in 1925. Public domain: published before 1931 (United States) and all authors died before 1972 (Canada).
